title: Idempotency claim result is discarded: event-id dedup is dead code and re-delivery is not gated
detail: The case block is a discarded expression; every branch returns Nil and execution continues to find/transition regardless. The 0-rows and Error branches never short-circuit, so the event-id dedup gates nothing.
recommended_fix: Return early on the 0-rows and Error branches so a claimed-or-already-processed event skips find/transition, mirroring payment/webhook_handler.gleam gating side effects on claim_stripe_event returning Duplicate.
